name: 21-ky-response-size-fast-path
title: Skip response size stream when Content-Length fits
body: When `maxResponseSize` is set and the response declares a Content-Length within the limit, return the response as-is instead of piping it through the byte-counting TransformStream.

bugs.why: Content-Length is server-controlled and is the compressed size when fetch decodes gzip/br, so a small or lying header bypasses maxResponseSize and allows unbounded (e.g. decompression-bomb) bodies.
